title: RETREAT_SAFE_TREE
source: Coordinator brief 2026-11-22 01:39 AM ET (P59 RETREAT SAFE TREE); F15 = P-D-024 death study (PR #152 table, F15 text in PR #175)
hypothesis: P48 dies mostly while retreating (F15: 60-67% of deaths). Its tree retreat (F3) walks to the NEAREST spot (1-3 s straight walk) that trees + buildings hide from every enemy that sees us. That spot is often hidden only by canopy, which stops counting once the enemy is inside near_range (45 m), and the nearest spot can lie on the attacker's side, so the walk keeps us in its fire and lets it close in. Choosing instead a spot whose line from each seer is blocked by a building or a tree trunk (holds at any range) and that does not lie toward the nearest threat keeps us hidden longer, so fewer retreats end in death.
mechanism: Only inside the champion's tree-retreat spot search (treeSpot, called only from the 'retreat, trees' branch, t >= 40 s, no drop run/hold, no near-and-reachable drop): with RETREAT_SAFE_TREE_ON, keep the champion's nearest-first search and its filters, but take the first spot that ALSO (a) has its center line from every seer's eye blocked by a building or a trunk (canopy ignored) and (b) lies more than RETREAT_SAFE_TREE_DEG (60 deg) away from the bearing to the nearest threat. If no spot passes, use the champion's nearest spot unchanged. Run state, skip list, stuck give-up, re-validation, move/boost/torso and every other mode unchanged.
activation: Decision-level: the champion's treeSpot returns a spot and the safe-tree search returns a different spot. Game-level Step A count = games where this happens at least once.
disproof: Fails if a different tree is chosen in < 10/192 retreats-games on either set (Step A), or if retreat deaths don't fall on both sets in the trees-on screen (practice bases 0 and 6000 here; the Sim Tester screen on 2000-5000 later).

novelty.vs_P57: P57 RETREAT_FACE_ON changes only the torso/aim target during the retreat (who we shoot back at); legs and path unchanged. P59 changes only which tree spot the legs walk to; torso/aim unchanged. Different decision, same retreat window, no shared code path beyond the retreat branch guard.
novelty.vs_EARLY_RETREAT_HIDE_ON: EARLY_RETREAT_HIDE_ON (Diego, #152) is retreat timing: tree/building hide before 40 s. Diego recommended outcome D (redundant with P48 v1 TREE_RETREAT_MIN_T 10, which raised early deaths); no record or code exists on any origin branch. P59 keeps the 40 s gate and the champion's timing; it changes only the spot choice.

overlap_check: No overlap (2026-11-22): P57 record (origin/p57-retreat-face) = torso/aim only; EARLY_RETREAT_HIDE_ON appears only as text in findings (diego/findings-mac-0540) and PR #152 comments, no code, no PR.
positives: Passive instrumentation confirmed the champion's tree retreat picks a spot in 67/192 and 70/192 games, and retreat deaths are 136/190 and 124/189 deaths (agrees with F15 and P57 Step A).
negatives: The champion's tree spot rarely differs from a 'trunk/building-blocked and not toward the nearest threat' spot: a safe spot exists in only 18 and 21 games per set, and it differs from the nearest spot in 9 and 7. Only 19 and 16 deaths per set happen in the 'retreat, trees' mode itself; most retreat deaths are in 'retreat to cover' or the plain back-away 'retreat', which this change cannot reach.
confidence: Disproven as specified (fires in < 10/192 games on both sets)
reuse: Don't rebuild a tree-choice refinement of P48 at this activation level. Geometry note (not measured): a 1-3 s step within 60 deg of a threat's bearing is closer to it unless the step exceeds its distance, so the champion's 'no closer to any seer' filter already excludes most attacker-side spots; and a 9 m mech is rarely hidden by trunks (median trunkR 0.32 m, median crownBase 3.2 m), so trunk-only cover is rare. Retreat-death work should target the plain 'retreat' and 'retreat to cover' modes instead.

step_a_result.method: log-only /tmp copy of champion code at f3c9eea (= b9492c6 bot code); inside treeSpot, after the champion's pick, the P59 safe-tree search (same nearest-first grid, skip list and filters, plus center line from every seer blocked by a building or trunk with canopy ignored, plus spot bearing > 60 deg from the nearest threat; fallback = champion pick) was computed and logged, action never changed. Trees-on sim copied from /workspace/wt-tester-trees/tools/sim (7b14b3a P-D-014 trees), --jobs 1, 96 seeds per base; per-seed traces via a /tmp copy of the tester's pass-through wrapper.
step_a_result.passivity: CSV rows identical to /workspace/tester/runs/trees-b9492c6-{2000,3000,4000,5000}.csv on every non-timing field for 384/384 seeds (timing fields bot_ms_mean, late_over_50ms, missed, bot_ready excluded).
step_a_result.retreat_death_definition: died and the last decision's mode starts with 'retreat' (retreat to cover / retreat, trees / retreat), same as P57's Step A; the counts match P57's per-base numbers.
step_a_result.note: Two extra diagnostic columns (angle-only / trunk-only differs) compared array identity instead of coordinates and are invalid; they are not reported.

sources: https://github.com/dmclaughlin-bit/mech-bot/pull/152 (P-D-024, EARLY_RETREAT_HIDE_ON proposal and Diego's outcome-D note)
